note: 240 mm Howitzer M1 on the M1 carriage in firing position, from its left, a halftone photograph with the tube at 15.2 degrees. No scale on it: the tube from the muzzle to the back of the breech ring is 8.41 m (L/35), which is 379.2 px along the bore and 45.09 px/m. The pin is the pivot the top carriage turns on, on the ground under the middle of the bottom carriage.
